entities.summary: Teutonic Order, a political institution in Estonia during Northern Crusades & Danish Estonia (1227–1346). Grew from Livonian Order and Founding of Tallinn (Castrum Danorum) by the Danes. Led to the emergence of St George's Night Uprising and Danish.
